server_scripts.name: CRM Share Lead on Owner Set
server_scripts.script:
# Auto-generated by setup-erpnext.mjs — share Lead/Opportunity with its
# designated owner field (lead_owner/opportunity_owner) when it differs from
# the record's creator, so "create on behalf of" grants real access.
owner_user = doc.get("lead_owner")
if owner_user and owner_user != doc.owner:
    if not frappe.db.exists("DocShare", {
        "share_doctype": doc.doctype,
        "share_name": doc.name,
        "user": owner_user,
    }):
        frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "DocShare",
            "user": owner_user,
            "share_doctype": doc.doctype,
            "share_name": doc.name,
            "read": 1,
            "write": 1,
        }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)
